description: MavLinOS keyboard shortcut skill groups (System Settings > Keyboard). Mirrors the action ids of lib/mv_hotkeys_core.SHORTCUTS; grouping data only, no binding data (the binding contract lives in xfce4-keyboard-shortcuts.xml).

skills.label: Spotlight Search
skills.description: System-wide search for files, applications and settings. macOS 10.9: Command-Space.

skills.label: Launchpad
skills.description: Application launcher grid. macOS 10.9: Command-L / F4 in the Dock.

skills.label: Mission Control
skills.description: Overview of all windows, Spaces and applications. macOS 10.9: F3 / Control-Up.

skills.label: Quick Look
skills.description: Peek at the selected item without opening it. macOS 10.9: Space / Command-Y.

skills.label: Screenshot
skills.description: Capture the screen or a selection. macOS 10.9: Command-Shift-3/4/5.

skills.label: Spaces & Mission Control
skills.description: Window overview, Space switching and per-Space window grouping.

skills.label: Window Management
skills.description: Move, resize, tile, minimize and close windows. macOS 10.9: M / H / W / Control-arrows.

skills.label: Application Switching
skills.description: Cycle windows and applications, hide, quit and force-quit. macOS 10.9: Command-Tab / Command-Q / Command-Option-Escape.

skills.label: Finder
skills.description: File operations that act on the Finder selection. macOS 10.9: Command-Shift-N / Command-I / Command-Delete.

skills.label: System
skills.description: System Settings, Control Center, Notification Center, lock, power and display. macOS 10.9: Command-, / Control-Command-Q.

skills.label: Keyboard & Input
skills.description: Brightness, audio and transport keys. These follow the hardware function row and are not freely rebindable.

contextual.label: Finder
contextual.note: In-window accelerators and the Thunar custom actions menu. These apply to the focused Finder window only and therefore have no global key.
